rationale.verdict: Walked solstice.finance, solstice.finance/security, solstice.finance/resources, and docs.solstice.finance/. Protocol architecture is well-documented (Squads 3/5 multisig, 24h timelock, non-upgradeable SPL programs for USX/eUSX/SLX) but no Solana program IDs or token mint addresses appeared in any fetched page. Halborn audit PDF was inaccessible, docs smart-contracts page was blocked by fetch allowlist, and no GitHub repo exists. Zero addresses catalogued; downstream slices cannot proceed without D1 (Solscan search) and D2/D3 (smart contracts doc / audit) being resolved.

evidence.shows: Protocol overview: Solana-native yield protocol with USX (overcollateralized stablecoin), eUSX (yield-bearing vault token), SLX (governance token), strcUSX and aiUSX (coming soon). Backed by Deus X Capital. Partners include Halborn, Chainlink, Kamino, Raydium, Orca, Pyth.

Security architecture: PDA-only minting (no human wallet can mint USX), non-upgradeable SPL programs for USX and SLX, Squads 3/5 multisig (3-of-5 independent signers required for any admin action, all signer addresses 'publicly disclosed' per page but not listed inline), 24-hour timelock on all admin transactions, Accountable Proof of Solvency, Hypernative monitoring, Halborn 3x audits + Sep2 audit.

Resources page listing audit reports (Halborn + Sep2 covering USX Program, YieldVault Program, governance contracts) at docs.solstice.finance/legal-documents/audits; technical USX documentation at docs.solstice.finance/solstice-for-users/usx; smart contracts documentation implied at docs.solstice.finance/solstice-for-builders.

GitBook docs confirm token family: USX (settlement layer, live), eUSX (yield-bearing, live), SLX (governance, live), aiUSX (coming soon), strcUSX (coming soon). Builders section includes Smart Contracts subsection.

protocol_metadata.about: Solstice is a Solana-native yield protocol that allows users to mint USX, an overcollateralized stablecoin backed by stablecoins and hedged assets, then deposit USX into YieldVault to receive eUSX, a yield-bearing token referencing delta-neutral basis-trading strategies. The protocol also issues SLX as a governance and access-gating utility token and offers liquid staking infrastructure. USX and SLX use non-upgradeable SPL programs with PDA-only minting authority, governed by a Squads 3-of-5 multisig with a 24-hour timelock on all admin actions. The protocol is developed by Solstice Labs AG, a Deus X Capital company, and has a stated 3-year track record with 13.96% net IRR.
